description: Start a cloud-browser LinkedIn reconnect for a client: opens the client's own scoped BAMF Cloud browser on the LinkedIn sign-in so THEY log in themselves. Credentials are never typed, stored, or returned by BAMF. Client-scoped: the client (or their agent), or the client's agency owner/admin/manager; client may be omitted when you have exactly one client space. TWO-STEP: confirm=false (default) returns the plan only and opens nothing; call again with confirm=true only after the user approves. Returns a session reference; follow progress with bamf.check_linkedin_session. Reports 'not available yet' until the cloud browser engine supports it.

client.description: Client workspace id, slug, or client name. Optional when you belong to exactly one client space.

confirm.description: false returns the plan only; true opens the cloud reconnect session.

name: bamf.reconnect_linkedin
